# Do you already have enough saved to coast to retirement?

> Free Coast FIRE and Barista FIRE calculator: see the savings you need today to coast to retirement, the age you cross that line, and the part-time income you need while coasting. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
